name: LFM3-Omni-2B

lineage.base_model: LFM3 backbone plus LFM3 vision encoder, LFM3 causal audio encoder and LiquidCodec tokenizer (card); audio-only sibling is lfm3-audio-2b

purpose: First omni-modal LFM3 model: one end-to-end model that understands text, images, video and audio and answers in text and speech; built for on-device use so that one model replaces a separate ASR model, VLM, LLM and TTS model (card).

license.name: LFM Open License v1.0
license.notes: Card header names lfm1.0 with a LICENSE file; the identically named LICENSE of LFM3-Audio-2B was read: commercial use only below USD 10,000,000 annual revenue, otherwise a separate agreement. The Omni repo's own LICENSE file was not opened. Verdict policy (README, 2026-11-19): this licence term does not lower tona_fit; kept here for an installer label.

architecture.kind: LFM3 backbone with LFM3 vision encoder, causal audio encoder and LiquidCodec audio tokenizer

variants.notes: Q8_0 1.85 GB; mmproj Q8_0 0.51 GB, BF16 0.95 GB; 521k downloads on the HF API

engine_support.notes: GGUF with mmproj published by the vendor.

strengths: Image, video with soundtrack and audio in one 2.2B model
weaknesses: No benchmark numbers read from the card
License limits commercial use above USD 10M revenue
German is a speech language of the card list but no German quality numbers read
soft.maturity: Liquid AI; 26k downloads (safetensors) and 521k (GGUF) on the HF API 2026-11-19.

tona_fit.reason: Small, convenient all-in-one model; unlikely to beat dedicated ASR, VLM and TTS models in quality. Keep as the reference for omni on-device models.
blockers: LFM3 architecture and vision/audio towers not in Tona
